record.one_liner: Vonage provides cloud communications APIs for voice, video, messaging, and verification.

auth_methods.quote: Vonage APIs support different authentication methods depending on which product you are using: API{filter} API Key and Secret (Header) JSON Web Token (JWT) Accounts Application Audit Channel Manager Conversation Conversion Device Location Retrieval Dispatch External Accounts Identity Insights Media Messages 1 Numbers Number Insight Pricing v1 Pricing v2 Programmable SIP Quality on Demand Redact Reports SMS Verify (Legacy) Verify 2 Voice 3 Video 1 Messages supports both JWT and Basic authentication

auth_methods.reason: The documentation lists API Key, Basic, and JSON Web Token (JWT) as authentication methods.
